performance.verdict: Meta efficient; Google burns $507 with zero conversions — fix attribution first.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $507.22 over 28 days with 0 recorded conversions; 112 clicks produced no measurable result — confirmed pixel/attribution failure, not ad failure.
5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: Stripe QA Jul 20): GHL gaps, stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch all unverified — each is a scale blocker per SOW.
GBP: 83 impressions and 41 direction actions over 28 days but 0 calls and 0 web clicks; call_rate is 0.00 — tracking break or listing misconfiguration confirmed.
GHL pipeline: 186 contacts, 131 opportunities created (value $0), 0 won, 0 appointments — leads arriving but pipeline stalled; intake leak, not an ads problem.
3-day signal (Sep 8–10): leads 10+12+6=28 vs prior 3 (Sep 5–7): 0+0+6=6 — strong Meta recovery after weekend zero-spend days; CPL trend holding near $15.85 baseline.

suggestions.text: Fix Google Ads conversion tracking — $507.22 spent with 0 conversions confirms pixel failure, not campaign failure.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $507.22 over 28 days and recorded 0 conversions despite 112 clicks — this is a confirmed pixel or attribution failure, not a campaign performance issue. Audit the Google Ads conversion tag on the landing page and verify it fires on form submission or call completion. Success check: at least one conversion recorded within 3 days of the fix going live. If the pixel fires correctly and conversions remain zero after 7 days, then campaign quality becomes the next question.

suggestions.text: Fix GBP call tracking — 83 impressions and 0 calls over 28 days signals a broken call button or tracking number misconfiguration.
suggestions.monday_update: The Liferun GBP listing recorded 83 impressions and 41 direction taps but exactly 0 calls over 28 days, which is not plausible organic behaviour — the call button or GBP-linked tracking number is almost certainly misconfigured. Verify the primary phone number on the listing routes correctly and that any call-tracking number forwarding is live. Success check: at least 1 call recorded in the GBP dashboard within 7 days of the fix. Re-check on 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL pipeline: 131 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — re-check conversion rate on 2026-09-18 after intake flows verified.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 186 contacts and 131 opportunities created but 0 appointments booked and 0 won deals — leads are arriving but nothing is progressing to activation. This is an intake or follow-up automation issue, not an ads problem. Hold any scaling decisions until the SOW-flagged BWS duplicate check and Becklar billing verification are completed (overdue since Aug 31). Re-check pipeline movement on 2026-09-18; if appointments remain at 0 by then, escalate to Nacer for CRM workflow audit.
